Laravel Composer library `pepperfm/api-responder-for-laravel`, active branch `3.x`; standardized API JSON responses via DI/Facade. Not a Laravel application; classes are under `Pepperfm\ApiBaseResponder` in `src/`.

Commands:
vendor/bin/pest --filter="test name"
vendor/bin/pest tests/Unit/ApiBaseResponderTest.php
composer lint-hard

`declare(strict_types=1)` is required in every PHP file (enforced by Pint). Laravel Pint preset/custom rules: `pint.json`. Class/function braces next line; control-structure braces same line; use `fn()`; import ordering none; `not_operator_with_successor_space`: false (use `!$var`); native types preferred over PHPDoc (`phpdoc_to_property_type`, `phpdoc_to_return_type` enabled).

Direct API: `ApiBaseResponder::response()`, `stored()`, `deleted()` resolve keys via config/private `buildJsonResponse()`; no `debug_backtrace()`. Builder bridge methods: `build()` blank; `forMethod('show')` REST context; `withDataKey('users')` explicit key; `fromAction()` reads calling-method PHP attributes using opt-in minimal backtrace. `ResponseBuilder` key priority: `withDataKey()` > `#[ResponseDataKey]` via `fromAction()` > `forMethod()` convention (`show`/`update` singular, otherwise plural) > `laravel-api-responder.plural_data_key`. `paginated()` uses `MetaResolver::resolve()` for `LengthAwarePaginator`/`CursorPaginator` data/meta, then `response()`.
